issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to call setup_env() with no parameters, but the solution implementation calls setup_env while pushing one argument (push 1) before the call. This creates a signature/parameter mismatch between the specification and the provided solution and may confuse students about whether they must pass an argument to setup_env.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement by removing the pushed argument before calling setup_env (remove 'push 1') and call setup_env with no parameters, or alternatively update the problem statement to specify that setup_env takes one parameter and document the expected argument. Also ensure the template includes an extern declaration for setup_env if students are expected to call it.
